start.description: A 0-D `Tensor` (scalar). Acts as first entry in the range if `limit` is not None; otherwise, acts as range limit and first entry defaults to 0.

limit.description: A 0-D `Tensor` (scalar). Upper limit of sequence, exclusive. If None, defaults to the value of `start` while the first entry of the range defaults to 0.

delta.description: A 0-D `Tensor` (scalar). Number that increments `start`. Defaults to 1.

dtype.description: The type of the elements of the resulting tensor.

output.description: An 1-D `Tensor` of type `dtype`. @compatibility(numpy) Equivalent to np.arange @end_compatibility
